meetings.name: Nuriootpa Wednesday
meetings.notes: The Wednesday Night AA Meeting in Nuriootpa, held each week at 7.30pm in the beautiful Barossa Valley, is believed to be the oldest continually running Alcoholics Anonymous meeting in South Australia. Since 1947, the group has offered friendship, support, and fellowship to all who attend. Newcomers and visitors are always warmly welcomed to this ID meeting, where tea, coffee, and light refreshments are shared together. Meetings are held in the hall behind St Boniface Anglican Church, down the laneway beside the NAB Bank.
